cases.prompt: 只用当前安装的 Skill，从当前 AI 热点里挑一个最适合做 2–3 分钟中文解释视频的题材，并直接给我研究型内容简报。
must_show: content format kept as a selection constraint
must_not: map short video to Radar platform filter
map 2–3 minute duration to Radar platform filter
map Chinese-language audience to Radar platform or source filter

cases.prompt: 今天有哪些 AI 题材值得中国普通科技用户继续研究？给我最值得看的三个，并说明为什么。
must_show: host editorial judgment visibly separated when claiming audience or China-market fit
unknowns when audience size or saturation is unmeasured
must_not: present wider audience as a Radar-measured fact
present China suitability as a measured field when it is host analysis

cases.prompt: 把当前选中的 AI Topic 做成 2–3 分钟中文研究型内容简报，保留事实边界。
cases.fixture_notes: Provide a fresh server-known topic and a complete successful Topic Insight response.
must_show: Radar facts separated from server Topic Insight analysis
server Insight used as the primary creative plan
host adaptation clearly treated as editorial analysis
must_not: present server insight as independently verified fact
invent a second incompatible creative plan solely for variety
add new factual specifics without Radar support or verification label

cases.prompt: 从当前 AI 热点里挑一个最适合做 2–3 分钟中文解释视频的题材，然后直接做成研究就绪的内容简报。
must_show: history or insight only for the selected finalist when needed
must_not: run another broad or bounded candidate selection after a valid handoff
rediscover the topic by title after valid handoff
